name: eight-hour-block-hourly-spacing-cost-band-004
rationale: The 8h-block / 1h-spacing variant (2026-10-07) was meant to test Willenbrock's rebalancing premium by restoring the held target hourly, but with allocation_threshold 0.1 an hourly drift correction requires a 10pp allocation drift, which an 8h window of BTC/JPY almost never produces (17 trades @500k vs ~16 for 8h/8h) — the mechanism barely operated. The Davis-Norman small-cost asymptotics give a no-trade half-width of roughly (3/(4*gamma) * pi^2 (1-pi)^2 * cost)^(1/3); at pi ~ 0.45, gamma = 1 and ~0.1% one-way cost (slippage + 50k-tier fee) that is ~0.035-0.04 allocation units. This narrows the band to 0.04 so drift corrections actually fire at the diagnostic capitals. At 50,000 JPY the lot floor (~25% of portfolio) dominates any threshold below ~0.25, so the primary verdict is expected to equal the 2026-10-07 8h/1h result's character and is not evidence about the band.

paper_reference.title: Transaction costs, trading volume, and the liquidity premium (asymptotics of the Davis-Norman no-trade region)
paper_reference.authors: Stefan Gerhold, Paolo Guasoni, Johannes Muhle-Karbe, Walter Schachermayer (building on Davis & Norman 1990, Janecek & Shreve 2004)
paper_reference.venue_year: Finance and Stochastics, 2014; see also Gerhold, Muhle-Karbe, Schachermayer, 'Asymptotics and duality for the Davis and Norman problem', Stochastics 2012
paper_reference.key_claim: With proportional transaction costs the optimal policy keeps the risky weight inside a no-trade band around the frictionless target, trading only at the band edges; for small costs the band half-width scales as the cube root of the cost rate times pi^2(1-pi)^2 / risk aversion.
paper_reference.pros: Gives a principled band width for exactly shirube's two-asset (BTC vs JPY cash) setting, mapping directly onto allocation_threshold with no code change; cube-root scaling implies the 0.1 band is ~2.5x wider than optimal at ~0.1% cost.
paper_reference.cons: Continuous-time Black-Scholes with constant target and log/power utility; shirube's target moves with a signal, trades back to the target (not the band edge, which Holden & Holden 2013 show is optimal), and at 50,000 JPY the 0.001 BTC lot floor is a fixed, not proportional, cost that makes any band below ~0.25 inert.
